Game Overview

Toilet Paper Please puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on dodge obstacles and avoid bouncing threats as you race against time, navigating creative levels as a plucky roll of toilet paper. This quirky, adrenaline-pumping adventure challenges your reflexes and wits across 45 thrilling stages and boss battles, promising endless laughter and engaging gameplay.

Playing Toilet Paper Please comes down to a simple loop. Dodge obstacles and avoid bouncing threats as you race against time, navigating creative levels as a plucky roll of toilet paper.
